svg.aria-label: The v8 agent system as the explorer's Agent tab draws it. The benchmark question, alone, enters one Claude Agent SDK session on Opus 5.5 at medium effort, at most 30 turns and 900 seconds, whose system prompt is system.md plus the code-built tables map, the version's notes for this dataset, and the upstream description and hints. The session reaches one in-process MCP server, dab, with three tools: query_db and describe_table run as the read-only dab_agent role on Postgres, and submit_answer takes the final SQL, a mode and the seven-step plan, re-runs the SQL as dab_agent and renders the result. The question's own validate.py judges the answer; the run folder keeps the results and the trace; the central MLflow indexes the run.
svg.title: One Opus session, three tools, one statement: the harness re-runs the SQL, so the result is known exactly

g.title: the user message: the benchmark question, verbatim, nothing else — src/dab_bench/agent/prompt.py

the Agent SDK session: a claude child on the subscription, claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort, at most 30 turns and 900 s; it starts in an empty directory with no CLAUDE.md, memory, plugin or built-in tool, and its init message is recorded on the trace — agents/v8_sql/agent.yaml, src/dab_bench/agent/session.py, isolation.py

the system prompt, composed per dataset: system.md (7,589 characters: how to work, then the seven-step SQL playbook the optimiser writes) + the code-built tables map + this dataset's notes (agents/v8_sql/datasets/<ds>.md, 1,384–1,928 characters) + the upstream description and hints verbatim; the curated pack is off — src/dab_bench/agent/prompt.py
one in-process MCP server per trial, named dab, with a strict config: the version's three tools and nothing else — src/dab_bench/agent/tools.py
query_db(sql, limit): one SELECT as dab_agent, read-only, a 60 s statement timeout, rows back cut at 10,000 characters; the work of the trial
describe_table(table): types, null rates and top values from the code-built profile, in one call

submit_answer(sql, mode, plan, answer?, step?): the final statement, re-run by the harness as dab_agent and rendered; mode pass_through makes that render the answer, mode derived keeps the model's answer and its one-line step; plan is the statement's seven steps; ends the trial — tools.py, plan s06 D27 and s08 D34

Postgres 16, the central platform's database dab: every table of the 12 datasets in one schema, 2,811 tables; dab_agent has SELECT on that schema only, a 60 s timeout, and no privilege on the schema that holds gold and goldens — infra/roles.sql
the judge: the question's own validate.py from upstream, alarm-bounded, over the submitted answer; pass or fail with the validator's reason — src/dab_bench/eval/validators.py
the run folder is the record: runs/<id>/run.json, results.jsonl with agent_sql, agent_result, mode, step and plan, one trace per trial
the central MLflow, experiment dataagentbench/evals: one run per eval, one trace per trial; linked, never read back inside a trial — src/dab_bench/tracking/mlflow_log.py

svg.text: 3 tools · read-only role · hints on · pack off
